acceptanceCriteria: A new .github/workflows/weekly-radar-guard.yml exists, triggered by schedule (00:30 UTC Monday, 30 minutes after the primary publish window) and workflow_dispatch, with permissions: contents: read only
The guard reconstructs only the data branch's weekly-radar tree and runs the existing --verify-published-as-of check; it never contacts Telegram's report-send path and never writes to data

When verification does not confirm publication for today, the guard sends exactly one plain-text Telegram alert message (reusing the existing ORGX_TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN/ORGX_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID secrets) with wording distinct from the actual report, then exits non-zero so the run shows red in Actions
docs/operations/WEEKLY_RADAR.md documents the guard: schedule, what it checks, that it never publishes or duplicates the report, and the human recovery step (manual gh workflow run weekly-radar.yml)
actionlint/yaml validation and make check pass; the reviewed PR is merged into main, the dedicated branch and worktree are removed, and main is synchronized and clean
goal: Add a read-only monitoring workflow that checks, shortly after the scheduled publish window, whether today's Weekly Radar report was actually published, and sends a Telegram alert (distinct from the report itself) when it was not, without ever re-publishing, re-acquiring sources, or writing to the data branch.
intent: Weekly Radar's scheduled GitHub Actions publish (cron 0 0 * * 1, 09:00 JST Monday) has been unreliable for three consecutive weeks: 2026-08-24 the schedule fired but failed on a since-fixed bug, 2026-08-31 it fired 4.5 hours late, 2026-09-07 it never fired at all and required a manual workflow_dispatch to send today's Telegram report. There is currently no automated signal when the scheduled report fails to arrive.
outOfScope: Changing the Rust CLI or the existing --verify-published-as-of command
Any auto re-publish or auto re-trigger of the real report send
